paper_metadata.title: MiniCPM-V 4.5: Cooking Efficient MLLMs via Architecture, Data, and Training Recipe
paper_metadata.abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) are undergoing rapid progress and represent the frontier of AI development. However, their training and inference efficiency have emerged as a core bottleneck in making MLLMs more accessible and scalable. To address the challenges, we present MiniCPM-V 4.5, an 8B parameter model designed for high efficiency and strong performance. We introduce three core improvements in model architecture, data strategy and training method: a unified 3D-Resampler model architecture for highly compact encoding over images and videos, a unified learning paradigm for document knowledge and text recognition without heavy data engineering, and a hybrid reinforcement learning strategy for proficiency in both short and long reasoning modes. Comprehensive experimental results in OpenCompass evaluation show that MiniCPM-V 4.5 surpasses widely used proprietary models such as GPT-4o-latest, and significantly larger open-source models such as Qwen2.5-VL 72B. Notably, the strong performance is achieved with remarkable efficiency. For example, on the widely adopted VideoMME benchmark, MiniCPM-V 4.5 achieves state-of-the-art performance among models under 30B size, using just 46.7\% GPU memory cost and 8.7\% inference time of Qwen2.5-VL 7B.

extraction_data.innovation: 3D-Resampler: jointly compresses video features across spatial and temporal dimensions to reduce compute; Hybrid reasoning reinforcement learning: mixes short and long reasoning samples during training to balance analytical depth and efficiency; Probability-based reward: complements rule-verification rewards for general domain response verification; Unified learning paradigm: jointly optimizes document knowledge and text recognition.
extraction_data.pretraining_task: Image captioning, OCR, document understanding, video captioning, next-token prediction
extraction_data.pretraining_corpus: LAION-2B, COYO, Common Crawl, OmniCorpus, MINT-1T, WebVid, Vript, OpenVid, curated Chinese image-text pairs, synthesized OCR data, document data
extraction_data.finetuning_task: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and hybrid Reinforcement Learning (RL) for short and long reasoning modes, Preference learning via DPO, hybrid RL, Multimodal instruction tuning
extraction_data.extension: Unified 3D-Resampler extends 2D-Resampler to jointly compress spatial-temporal information for videos, achieving 6x temporal compression and up to 96x overall video token compression.
extraction_data.research_problem: Building efficient Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) capable of high frame rate and long video understanding, controllable hybrid reasoning, robust OCR, and strong document parsing.
extraction_data.application: STEM reasoning, document/OCR/chart understanding, hallucination evaluation, multi-image/real-world understanding, video understanding, comprehensive multimodal understanding
extraction_data.paper_title: MiniCPM-V 4.5: Cooking Efficient MLLMs via Architecture, Data, and Training Recipe
extraction_data.training_pipeline: Pre-training -> SFT -> RL (hybrid short/long reasoning modes)
extraction_data.reasoning_mode: Hybrid: short reasoning mode for efficient usage, long reasoning mode (step-by-step) for complex tasks; controlled via hybrid RL post-training
extraction_data.synthetic_data_generation_method: Synthesized OCR data (rendering text on natural scenes and HTML sources); Capsfusion-based re-captioning for image captions
extraction_data.rl_algorithm: Reinforcement Learning (RL) with hybrid short/long reasoning modes, DPO, Hybrid RL, RLAIF-V, hybrid reinforcement learning
extraction_data.reward_mechanism: Probability-based reward for general reasoning data, complementing rule-only approach., Rule-based reward for simple responses, probability-based reward for complex natural language responses; standardized preference reward score via RLAIF-V with claim-level verification, Rule-verification reward combined with probability-based reward
extraction_data.fusion_architecture: Unified 3D-Resampler using cross-attention with learnable queries augmented with 2D spatial positional embeddings (images) and 2D spatial + temporal positional embeddings (videos)
extraction_data.vision_encoder: Lightweight visual encoder with image partitioning strategy for high-resolution images and high frame rate/long videos
